intro.text: A dressmaker in a river town who mistreats his sister after putting a dress she designed in his shop.
A dressmaker in First Dukeseat who struck his sister Tamantha after her designs nearly cost him his shop.

items.text: He bought Tamantha's designs and displayed them instead of famous dressmakers' work, which almost ruined him. In a rage he hit her and told her she deserved it. December overheard, and had Amaal announce that she would visit the shop.

December found fault with all his wares, then asked for Tamantha's dress. To keep his sister from earning a commission he gave it away free, so December tipped Tamantha its price; she used it to buy back her designs and left to join December.
